scope: Standalone affinity helper; no model, loss, evaluator, or training changes
forward_contract: Matches spike_synchrony_affinity in float conversion, settle slicing, temporal centering, norm clamp, matrix multiplication, correlation clamp, component stack order, positive clamp, and component product.
backward_intervention: For each centered trace norm <= the existing eps (default 1e-8), detach only the already-computed normalized trace in backward. Forward values remain unchanged.

training_contract.source_recipe: SW0117 candidate recipe and immutable lambda remain unchanged

tests: test_affinity.py checks exact forward equality, degenerate/valid trace gradient behavior, settle ordering, and epsilon boundary. These are synthetic tests, not model-level or training evidence.
